title: Automated Debugging Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Error signatures, reproduction steps, root causes, patches, and regression tests. The Automated Debugging Database turns debugging from art into procedure: every bug gets an error signature (the recognizable shape of the failure), minimal reproduction steps, the diagnosed root cause, the patch that fixed it, and a regression test that keeps it fixed. Patterns repeat across projects — null dereferences, off-by-ones, race conditions, resource leaks — so a database of diagnosed bugs makes the next diagnosis faster and the fix more likely correct.

title: Automated Debugging Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Debugging procedure: REPRODUCE (minimal case, deterministic) -> ISOLATE (bisect: which change/input triggers it) -> DIAGNOSE (root cause, with evidence) -> PATCH (minimal change addressing the cause) -> VERIFY (repro passes, suite passes) -> REGRESS (test added). Signature taxonomy: crashes (null deref, index errors, assertion failures), wrong-output (off-by-one, rounding, logic inversions), hangs (deadlock, livelock, infinite loop), leaks (unclosed resources, unbounded growth), flakiness (ordering, timing, unseeded randomness). Bisection: git-bisect style halving finds the culprit change in O(log n). Root-cause discipline: 'five whys' from symptom to defect; fix the defect, not the symptom. Patch rules: minimal diff, no drive-by refactors, regression test in the same change.

demo.title: Execution: build pipeline generate-build-test-fix
demo.code: let attempts=0;function build(code){attempts++;return code.includes('BUG')?{ok:false,log:'compile error: BUG token'}:{ok:true,log:'build clean'};}let code='v1 with BUG';let res=build(code);while(!res.ok&&attempts<5){code=code.replace('BUG','FIX');res=build(code);}J({attempts,ok:res.ok,log:res.log});assert(res.ok&&attempts===2,'buildloop');

Runnable workflow: the signature matcher scores an error report against the catalog; the reproducer runs minimization on a failing input; the bisect simulator finds the culprit change in a commit list; the patch verifier runs the repro + suite against a proposed patch. Demos execute signature matching, input minimization on a sample failure, bisection over a commit history, and patch verification.

demo.title: Verification: property-based test of sort
demo.code: function prop(a){const s=[...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y);const sorted=s.every((v,i)=>i===0||s[i-1]<=v);const perm=JSON.stringify([...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y))===JSON.stringify(s);return sorted&&perm;}let seed=42;function rnd(){seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return seed%100;}let pass=true;for(let t=0;t<200;t++){const a=Array.from({length:10},rnd);if(!prop(a)){pass=false;break;}}J({trials:200,pass});assert(pass,'property');

title: Automated Debugging Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: signature test (known errors match their signatures); minimization test (reduced cases still fail and are smaller); bisection test (culprit found in log steps); patch test (patch fixes repro without breaking the suite). Limitations: novel failures need new signatures; minimization needs a deterministic oracle; patches are verified by tests, not proven. Every bug record links repro, cause, patch, and regression test.

demo.title: Execution: debugging signature match and bisection
demo.code: const sigs=[{re:/index out of range/i,cause:'off-by-one'},{re:/null|undefined/i,cause:'null-deref'}];const err='IndexError: list index out of range';const m=sigs.find(s=>s.re.test(err));const commits=['c1','c2','c3','c4','c5','c6','c7','c8'];const bad=5;let lo=0,hi=commits.length-1,steps=0;while(lo<hi){steps++;const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(mid>=bad)hi=mid;else lo=mid+1;}J({cause:m.cause,culprit:commits[lo],steps});assert(m.cause==='off-by-one'&&commits[lo]==='c6'&&steps===3,'debug');
